name: person_id
description: The person_id created by removing the first character form the RDR participantId

name: suspension_status
description: The status of suspension for a participant, as supplied by the participant summary, or the reason a linked adult's lifecycle event deactivated this participant. Supplied values include NOT_SUSPENDED and NO_CONTACT; derived values are deactivated_by_linked_adult_withdrawal and deactivated_by_linked_adult_deactivation

name: deactivated_datetime
description: The date and time a participant's status was set to NO_CONTACT
